record.summary: Henning Larsen's 13-story, 299,600 sq ft office building at 300 Toni Stone Crossing, fully leased to Visa as its global headquarters since a November 2019 announcement. open_questions: Construction cost and Visa's lease term and rent: not disclosed in anything read (Bisnow gave no term).
Vertical construction start date: SF YIMBY says early summer 2021; the Port's December 2021 update says the site was 'approximately one year into' Phase 1 construction. No groundbreaking date found.
LEED: only a 2021 'aiming for Gold'; no certification record found.

Address: status.csv previously gave Visa's address as 1051 3rd St, an address that two Building B sources (Mitsui Fudosan press page, CommercialSearch listing) attach to Building B; removed from status.csv 2026-09-29. The building is at Toni Stone Crossing and Dr. Maya Angelou Lane (SF Examiner, Sept 2024), 300 Toni Stone Crossing (Fieldwork page).
The Fieldwork grand opening is dated by a press release (dateline July 28, 2026) that says 'Saturday, July 26'; July 26, 2026 was a Sunday, so the exact day is not settled.

Images: no 'before' photo is hosted (until 2020 the parcel was the Seawall Lot 337 surface parking lot) and no rendering is hosted because the architects' renderings are not openly licensed; they are reachable through the architect sources listed here.

Visa's exact move-in date: the Port's Oct 2023 and April 2024 memos give expected occupancy (1Q24, April 2024); the earliest post-event sources read are Visa's June 2024 announcement (per SF Examiner) and SF YIMBY on Sept 5, 2024.
Tenants shown open on old sources (Via Aurelia, Proper Food) rest on sources dated Oct 2025 and Sept 2024 respectively; not re-confirmed since.
